public boolSQLite3::busyTimeout intmilliseconds
Sets a busy handler that will sleep until the database is not locked or the timeout is reached.
The busy handler is built into SQLite, so no callback has to be provided. When a statement finds the database locked by another connection, SQLite keeps retrying for up to milliseconds. If the database is still locked after that, the statement fails with a database is locked error.
By default no busy handler is set, so a statement fails right away if the database is locked.
